schema.thickness: Thickness of the wall in millimeters.
schema.location_line: Revit wall location line (e.g., WallCenterline, FinishFaceInterior, FinishFaceExterior).
schema.top_constraint: Determines how the top of the wall behaves (NextLevel or Unconnected).
schema.top_level: Explicit override for the top level (must match a valid level name).
schema.unconnected_height: Explicit height in millimeters if top_constraint is Unconnected.
schema.top_offset: Vertical offset from the top constraint in millimeters.
schema.family_name: The exact name of the target Revit family type.
schema.is_floor: Boolean (true/false) flag to tell Revit this is a floor, not a wall.
schema.floor_type: The exact name of the target Revit Floor family type.
